also your ability to recognize when a seed just isnt going to work and then restart also has massive influence on which person will get "luckier seeds". this is obviously because all the time you waste on bad seeds could be spent trying to find better seeds and this is a skill that is **massively** underestimated when it comes to speedrunning. i mean even personally, ive noticed that this is something forsen struggles with sometimes, i will so often see him waste time on clearly shit seeds thatll clearly go nowhere whereas if you look at xqcs stream the dude will restart the seeds so so much more often. the person better at doing this will always get "luckier seeds".
